nina: FYI weekly release train bulletin — small cadence & canary updates, please scan.
nina: Quiet window scheduled 2023-05-02T01:00Z -> 2023-05-02T09:00Z. Were also tightening ramp limits for KV-cache touching changes: max 5%/shard per 10m.
release-bot: Quiet window set for 2023-05-02T01:00:00Z. Ramp limits policy applied.
omar: Noted. We have a canary in flight that touches cache TTL. Should we pause?
sre-oncall: Pause recommended. We saw a 40% increase in retry traffic during a TTL experiment yesterday; no user impact yet but risk is non-trivial. Auto-pause will trigger for similar spikes.
leo: Ill hold the change and re-run the smoke script: infra/tests/canary_kv_smoke.sh --sample prod --duration 20m.
omar: Thanks. One policy question: does the 5%/shard rollback reserve mean we need to pre-allocate capacity before starting canary?
nina: Yes — rollout ops requires verifying "rollback_reserve >= 5% per shard" before unpause. Add a note on the PR with the verification output. If you cant guarantee it, raise a spot-check with #release-ops.
release-bot: Canary status: v5.2 = PAUSED (auto). Rollout policy: KV-cache ramp = 5%/10m.
sre-oncall: Action items: 1) platform to run scoped smoke (leo) 2) ops to add verification step in deploy pipeline (nina) 3) docs: add short FAQ on rollback-reserve check (nina).
leo: Running smoke now, will post result in 25m.
release-bot: Reminder: emergency exceptions only during quiet window. Use #release-ops and include 2 approvers from eng-leads + ops.
nina: Thanks all. Hold noncritical merges touching cache layers until were green. Will update if anything changes. :thumbsup:
